title: Edward the Confessor
summary: Raleigh names Edward the Confessor in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Edward the Confessor, named with William the Conqueror in the same example. He is not King Edward who was in prison with King Richard, and not Prince Edward. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXV, §. I, sig. 351a–351b
